As a candidate, you need to contact the hiring company or recruiter who invited you to the assessment. They can reschedule or extend your test access using HackerRank for Work features:

1. **Extend the test window** — The test owner can modify the test expiration time (start/end date and time) in Settings > General to reopen the assessment period. [Article 2979262079]
2. **Reinvite you** — If you already received an invite or attempted the test, the recruiter can reinvite you at any time; this sends a new invitation without deleting the previous one first. [Article 1002936098]
3. **Add time accommodation** — If you haven't started the test, they can add a time accommodation (percentage-based extra duration) before or after sending invites. [Article 4811403281]
4. **Delete a prior submission** — If you already submitted, they can delete that submission (which resets your status to Invited) and then reinvite you. [Article 9556988565]

HackerRank Support cannot reschedule assessments on behalf of the hiring company; only the test administrator can make these changes.
justification: Article 2979262079 describes modifying test expiration time to control when a test remains active. Article 1002936098 explains reinviting candidates to retake a test. Article 4811403281 covers adding time accommodation for candidates who haven't started. Article 9556988565 details deleting a test submission to allow a reattempt. All actions require test owner/editor access in HackerRank for Work.

To remove an interviewer from the platform, you need to deactivate their user account via the User Management section. Ensure you have Company Admin permissions, then follow these steps:

1. Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner and select **Admin Panel**.
2. Click your profile icon in the admin panel and select **User Management**.
3. Use the search bar or filters to locate the interviewer.
4. Click the ellipsis (...) icon next to their name and select **Deactivate User**.
5. Click **Deactivate** in the confirmation dialog box to confirm.

If you still do not see the option, verify that you are in the User Management section and that your account has the Company Admin role.

To create a resume using HackerRank Resume Builder:
1. Log in to HackerRank Community.
2. Click the App Switcher (grid icon) in the top‑right corner.
3. Select Resume Builder from the dropdown.
4. Click Create New.
5. Choose a template (Classic or Modern) and click Confirm.
6. In the Resume Dashboard, expand Resume Details and fill in Personal Information, Experience, Education, Skills, Projects, Certificates, and Additional sections.
7. View the real‑time preview on the right.

To import an existing resume:
1. Log in to HackerRank Community.
2. Click the App Switcher (grid icon) in the top‑right corner.
3. Select Resume Builder.
4. Click Import Resume.
5. Drag‑and‑drop your .doc, .docx, or .pdf file or click Choose a file to browse.
6. Click Continue; the system will pre‑fill sections.
7. Select a template (Classic or Modern) via Change Template if desired.
8. Expand Resume Details to review and edit as needed.
9. View the real‑time preview.
Source(s): https://help.hackerrank.com/articles/9106957203-create-a-resume-with-resume-builder
